_doc: Lie-check catalogue (docs/GAME_KNOWLEDGE.md section 2). Each check lists the inputs the engine needs, how confident a hit is, the EvidenceItem category it belongs to, its effect (suspect = raises the player, clear = lowers, invalidateClear = a claimed clear proves nothing, constraint = narrows kill windows or impostor counts) and a chat question (<= 70 chars) with placeholders {P} player, {P2} second player, {R} room, {R2} other room, {T} time m:ss, {TASK} task, {W} witness, {V} victim, {N} number. 'situation' links to a crew.json situation; 'wiredIn' names the engine rule that already implements it (null = not yet). Inputs use the vocabulary in 'inputVocabulary'; entries starting with * there do not exist in the domain model yet.

inputVocabulary.lobby.roles: * which roles are enabled (Engineer, Shapeshifter, Phantom, Viper, Scientist ...)
inputVocabulary.facts.monitors: src/data/gameFacts.json maps.<id>.monitors (admin rooms, cam feeds + nearRooms, vitals, doorlog, binoculars)
inputVocabulary.facts.rules: gameFacts.json rules (cooldowns, comms effects, admin behaviour)
inputVocabulary.meeting.overview: dead players shown at meeting start

checks.name: Visual task claimed but no animation while I watched
checks.check: Visuals on, task is visual on this map, I watched P at that panel for the whole claimed duration and saw no effect.
checks.ask: {P} {TASK} is visual. I watched and saw nothing.
caveats: Visuals off: only the doer sees it.
A ghost doing the same visual elsewhere does not matter.

checks.name: Clear based on a task that is not visual on this map
checks.check: Asteroids/Shields on MIRA, anything on Airship/Fungle, Garbage outside Skeld are not visual. The clear proves nothing (the clearer is not guilty for it).
checks.ask: {TASK} is not visual on this map. That clears nobody.
caveats: Common mistake by new players; do not treat the clearer as impostor.

checks.name: Visual clear while visuals are off
checks.check: With visuals off nobody but the doer sees the effect. Exception: Submit Scan "Waiting for <name>".
checks.ask: Visuals are off. Only scan waiting proves it.

checks.name: Claims a common task the lobby does not have
checks.check: Common tasks are identical for every crewmate. If the claimed task is a common task on this map and it is not on my list, the claim is false.
checks.ask: {TASK} is common. I dont have it. Nobody does.
caveats: Only valid when my task list is known (setup screen).
Name aliasing (wires vs divert): confirm the task id.

checks.name: Claims a task that does not exist on this map
checks.check: Task id not in map.tasks (e.g. scan on Airship/Fungle, divert power on Polus/Fungle, swipe card on MIRA/Airship/Fungle).
checks.ask: There is no {TASK} on this map {P}.
caveats: Players use other maps' names; ask before voting.

checks.name: Claims a task in a room where it has no stage
checks.check: Claimed room not in task.rooms for this map.
checks.ask: {TASK} is not in {R}. Which panel {P}?
caveats: Some wiring panels sit in the corridor outside the named room.

checks.name: Seen using a dummy (impossible) task panel
checks.check: Dummy panels: Skeld Reactor divert power, Polus Office divert power, Airship Armory/Communications/Vault wiring, Airship Lounge garbage bin.
checks.ask: {P} that panel in {R} is fake. Nobody can do it.
caveats: Dummy panel list: src/data/gameFacts.json maps.<id>.dummyPanels.

checks.name: Multi-stage task done in an impossible order
checks.check: Stage order is fixed: Skeld upload always Admin, Polus upload Communications, divert before accept, garbage/chute final stage Storage, align upper then lower.
checks.ask: {P} upload is always in admin. Where did you download?
caveats: Map JSON lists rooms but not stage order; needs rooms per stage.

checks.name: Wiring panels claimed in an order the game never assigns
checks.check: Wiring order per map: Skeld Elec>Storage>Admin>Nav>Cafe>Sec; MIRA Storage>Hallway>Locker>Greenhouse>Lab; Polus Elec>O2>Office>Decon>Lab R>Lab L; Airship Viewing>Engine>Main Hall>Showers>Lounge>Cargo>Meeting.
checks.ask: {P} wires go in a fixed order. {R} cant come after {R2}.

checks.name: Left a task faster than its minimum time
checks.check: Observed time at the panel < 0.6 x stageDurationSec (download/upload ~9-11 s, scan ~10 s, inspect sample 60 s wait).
checks.ask: {P} you were at {TASK} for a few seconds. It takes longer.
caveats: Most durations in map JSON are guesses; only download, scan and sample are sourced.

checks.name: Task bar did not move when P finished a single-stage task
checks.check: Bar mode Always, single-stage task, P closed it as done in my view, no bar movement within ~1 s.
checks.ask: {P} you said done {TASK}. The bar did not move.
caveats: Multi-stage tasks only move the bar at the final stage.
Comms hides bar progress.

checks.name: Task bar moved exactly when P finished (soft clear)
checks.check: Bar mode Always, start of round, P finished a single-stage task and the bar moved with nobody else likely finishing.
checks.ask: Bar moved when {P} finished {TASK}. Soft clear.
caveats: Another crewmate finishing at the same moment fakes this.

checks.name: Wanders with no task activity
checks.check: Seen several times in a round, never at a panel, in rooms with no plausible task.
checks.ask: {P} what tasks did you do this round? Name two.
caveats: Late game crew may have finished all tasks.

checks.name: Cannot name a task or its location
checks.check: Asked twice, answers with no task name, or a task but no room.
checks.ask: {P} which task exactly and where?
caveats: Quick Chat users cannot type freely.

checks.name: Two placements closer in time than the walk allows
checks.check: gap < shortestPathSec / playerSpeed x 0.7 => impossible on foot; if both rooms are on one vent network, flag "vented".
checks.ask: {P} you were in {R} at {T}. {R2} is too far for that.
caveats: Travel seconds are eyeballed; keep 30% slack.
MIRA vents connect everything.

checks.name: Entered a watched dead-end and was gone
checks.check: I watched the only door of a dead-end; P went in, the room was later empty or P was seen elsewhere without coming out. Room has a vent.
checks.ask: {P} went into {R} and was gone. Theres a vent there.
caveats: Phantom vanish if Phantom is enabled.
Engineers can vent.

checks.name: Appeared in a room nobody walked into
checks.check: I was watching the entrances of R; P appears inside; R has a vent.
checks.ask: {P} how did you get to {R}? Nobody came through.
caveats: Vision edges; ask before voting.

checks.name: Airship Gap Room crossed too fast
checks.check: Seen on one side of Gap Room, then the other side faster than the platform ride or the long route; Gap Room left/right vents connect.
checks.ask: {P} you crossed gap without the platform. How?

checks.name: Ladder trip nobody heard
checks.check: Ladder sound plays map-wide on Airship/Fungle; a claimed climb at a time nobody heard one is doubtful.
checks.ask: {P} which ladder? Nobody heard one.
caveats: Players rarely track ladder sounds; low weight.

checks.name: Kill time inside the post-meeting cooldown
checks.check: Kill cooldown resets at every meeting end (10 s at match start). Earliest kill = meetingEnd + cooldown (+ time the killer spent in vents or on cams). Alibis covering only that window prove nothing.
checks.ask: First kill cant be before {N}s. Where were you after?
caveats: Kill-during-meeting-call glitch can place a body at the button.

checks.name: Two bodies closer than one cooldown
checks.check: Time-of-death gap < killCooldownSec => two different killers. One impostor can never double kill.
checks.ask: Two kills {N}s apart. That is two impostors.
caveats: Time of death must be bounded (vitals, noisemaker, sightings).

checks.name: Named companion denies
checks.check: P claims to be with W; W says no (or names someone else). One of them lies; the one with other contradictions is the liar.
checks.ask: {W} were you with {P}? Yes or no.
caveats: Both may be honest about different minutes.

checks.name: Location or companion changed for the same window
checks.check: Two claims by P for overlapping windows name different rooms or companions.
checks.ask: Last meeting {P} said {R}. Now {R2}. Which?
caveats: Players misname rooms; check aliases.

checks.name: Avoids giving a location
checks.check: Asked where, answers with a question or only after others have given theirs.
checks.ask: {P} you still havent said where you were.
caveats: Slow typers, translation lag.

checks.name: Two players only ever alibi each other
checks.check: Across >= 2 meetings P and P2 clear each other and nobody else confirms either.
checks.ask: {P} and {P2} only clear each other. Who else saw you?
caveats: Real duos (friends) do this as crew.

checks.name: Left alone together, one died
checks.check: I saw only P and V together in R; V found dead in or near R soon after with no third player seen.
checks.ask: I left {P} alone with {V} in {R}. Then {V} died.
caveats: A Shapeshifter may have worn P.
Vents let a third player arrive unseen.

checks.name: Left the body room shortly before the report
checks.check: P seen leaving R within ~15 s before the body in R was reported; P did not report.
checks.ask: {P} you came out of {R} right before. Didnt see {V}?
caveats: The body may have been out of P's vision.

checks.name: Walked past a body
checks.check: P was within vision of the body location after the kill and kept walking.
checks.ask: {P} you walked right past the body in {R}.
caveats: Lights shrink crew vision ~5x.
Doors block reports.

checks.name: Report seconds after the kill, no witness
checks.check: Report time minus time of death (vitals OK->DED, noisemaker alert) under ~5 s and nobody saw the reporter arrive.
checks.ask: {P} you found {V} seconds after the kill. Who did you see?
caveats: Crew who witnessed the kill also report instantly.

checks.name: Reporter had no reason to be in that dead-end
checks.check: Body in a dead-end; the reporter claims no task there (or a task that is not in that room).
checks.ask: {P} what task took you to {R}?

checks.name: Claimed route cannot reach the body in time
checks.check: Reporter says they came from R2; the path R2->R would pass me or a watched corridor, or takes longer than the time available.
checks.ask: {P} from {R2} you would pass me. You didnt.

checks.name: Saw or reported a body through closed doors
checks.check: Bodies cannot be reported through closed doors and doors block vision.
checks.ask: Doors were shut. You couldnt see into {R}.
caveats: A body right at the door can bug through.

checks.name: Knows details nobody announced
checks.check: P names the body room, victim or body count before the reporter or anyone else said it, without having been there.
checks.ask: {P} how did you know it was in {R}? Nobody said.
caveats: The meeting overview shows who died, so victim names are public.
Ghost info can leak via voice calls.

checks.name: Killer skipped a closer player
checks.check: Impostors cannot kill impostors: if K killed far-away V while P stood closer, P is likely K's partner.
checks.ask: {P2} was closer to {P}. Why was {V} the target?
caveats: Rare; ping and movement break it.

checks.name: Victim dead with no body (Viper)
checks.check: Player shown dead at meeting / DED on vitals but no body anywhere: Viper acid dissolved it (default 15 s).
checks.ask: No body for {V}. Viper is on. Who was near {R}?
caveats: Only when the Viper role is enabled.

checks.name: Read a monitor during Comms
checks.check: Comms disables Admin, Cams, Vitals and Doorlog (not Fungle binoculars). A claimed reading inside a comms window is false.
checks.ask: Comms were down. Cams and admin were off then.
caveats: Check the exact comms window; readings just before it are fine.

checks.name: Claims a monitor this map does not have
checks.check: No cams on MIRA, no admin on Fungle, no vitals on Skeld/MIRA (except Scientist), doorlog only on MIRA.
checks.ask: There are no cams on this map {P}.
caveats: Scientist has portable vitals on any map.

checks.name: Admin count disagrees with claims
checks.check: My admin read: N icons in R at T. Claims put a different number of players in R at T.
checks.ask: Admin had {N} in {R} at {T}. Who else was there?
caveats: Admin is anonymous and updates as people move; allow +-5 s.
Admin icons include dead bodies until the next meeting.
No admin observation type in the model yet.

checks.name: Admin shows someone where I see nobody
checks.check: Admin icon in a room I am standing in or watching, nobody visible => someone is in that room's vent.
checks.ask: Admin showed someone in {R} but it was empty.
caveats: Only meaningful for rooms with a vent.

checks.name: Evidence from an area admin does not cover
checks.check: Admin does not show hallways or Polus Outside. "Admin showed nobody there" is no evidence for those areas.
checks.ask: Admin doesnt show {R}. That proves nothing.

checks.name: Not on camera where they claim to have walked
checks.check: I watched a feed covering corridor C for the window; P claims to have walked through C then and never appeared.
checks.ask: I was on cams. {P} never walked past {R}.
caveats: Polus/Airship feeds show one camera at a time.
No cams observation type yet; feed coverage is in gameFacts.json monitors.cams.

checks.name: Claims cams but nobody saw them blink
checks.check: Living viewers make every camera blink red. If several players near cameras saw no blink, the cams claim is doubtful.
checks.ask: {P} you were on cams? Nobody saw them blink.
caveats: Polus/Airship cams can be body-blocked; quick re-entry avoids the blink.

checks.name: Doorlog disagrees with the claimed route
checks.check: MIRA doorlog logs living players at the north/SW/SE hallway sensors (5 s per-player cooldown, last 20 events, real identity even if shifted).
checks.ask: Doorlog has {P} at the {R} sensor at {T}.
caveats: Comms wipes the display until fixed.

checks.name: Claim contradicts the vitals time of death
checks.check: Vitals showed V OK at T; any claim of finding V dead before T is false. DED = killed since the last meeting, body present.
checks.ask: {V} was alive on vitals at {T}. Not before.
caveats: D/C also covers disconnects and earlier deaths.

checks.name: Claims fixing a sabotage where it cannot be fixed
checks.check: Fix points: Skeld reactor Reactor, O2 O2+Admin, lights Electrical, comms Comms; MIRA reactor Reactor, O2 Greenhouse+SW hall, lights Office, comms Office+Comms; Polus seismic both sides of Dropship, lights Electrical, comms outside by Comms; Airship crash both sides of Gap Room, lights Gap/Viewing/Cargo, comms Comms; Fungle reactor Reactor, comms Comms+Lookout, no lights.
checks.ask: {TASK} isnt fixed in {R} on this map.

checks.name: Absent from a critical sabotage
checks.check: Critical sabotage; P seen at neither fix point and claims a location far from both.
checks.ask: {P} reactor was called. Where were you?
caveats: Plenty of crew ignore sabotages.

checks.name: "I fixed it" offered as a clear
checks.check: Impostors can fix sabotages. Fixing proves nothing alone; only a 2-person fix with a cleared partner is an alibi for that moment.
checks.ask: Impostors can fix too. Who was with you?

checks.name: Two-person fix partner does not match
checks.check: Reactor/seismic need two hands at once; P claims W held the other reader; W denies or was seen elsewhere.
checks.ask: {W} were you on the other reactor hand with {P}?

checks.name: Impossible Airship spawn
checks.check: Airship spawn choices after a meeting are only Brig, Cargo Bay, Engine Room, Kitchen, Main Hall, Records (3 offered each time).
checks.ask: You cant spawn in {R} on Airship.
caveats: Players often name where they walked first, not the spawn.

checks.name: Sighting made during Mushroom Mixup
checks.check: During Fungle Mushroom Mixup (~10 s) every living player has a random colour and crew cannot see names: drop colour-based sightings in that window.
checks.ask: That was during mixup. Colours were random.

checks.name: Saw P enter or leave a vent
checks.check: Hard if Engineers are off. With Engineers: hard if P re-vented within the engineer cooldown, vented during comms, or stayed longer than the max vent time.
checks.ask: I saw {P} vent in {R}.
caveats: Clean Vent forcing someone out is the same evidence.

checks.name: Saw P kill
checks.check: Hard unless Shapeshifter is enabled (the killer may wear P's look). An acid (Viper) kill is hard even then: Viper and Shapeshifter cannot both be on.
checks.ask: I saw {P} kill {V} in {R}.

checks.name: Saw a shapeshift cocoon or Phantom cloud
checks.check: The cocoon/cloud is in the impostor's real colour.
checks.ask: I saw {P} shift in {R}. Same colour cloud.

checks.name: Saw two players with the same look
checks.check: Two identical players at once: one is a Shapeshifter. Watch both; the one that changes back is the impostor.
checks.ask: Two {P}s at once. One of them is a shapeshifter.
caveats: Same cosmetics but different colours is not this.

checks.name: First accuser with no sighting
checks.check: P accuses before any location was given and offers no sighting when asked.
checks.ask: {P} what did you actually see? Sus is not a location.
caveats: Loud crew do this all the time.

checks.name: Switches target when countered
checks.check: P accuses A; A counters with an alibi; P accuses someone else without addressing it.
checks.ask: {P} you dropped {P2} fast. Why were you sure before?

checks.name: Always votes last and with the majority
checks.check: Across meetings P's vote lands after most votes and always on the leading target. Needs non-anonymous votes.
checks.ask: {P} you always vote last. Who do you think it is?
caveats: Slow players and translators vote late too.

checks.name: Agrees without adding information
checks.check: "+1", "same", "yeah its X" with no observation, especially from someone who has not given a location.
checks.ask: {P} what did you see yourself?

checks.name: Hard-defended a confirmed impostor
checks.check: P vouched for, or claimed to be with, a player later ejected as impostor (confirm ejects on).
checks.ask: {P} why were you so sure {P2} was clear?
caveats: Marinated crew do this honestly.

checks.name: Long unprompted alibi
checks.check: Long, detailed, unasked-for alibi; impostors over-build stories.
checks.ask: {P} short version. Room and who saw you.

checks.name: The player who accused P died next
checks.check: P was accused last meeting and the accuser is the next victim. Can also be a frame by another impostor.
checks.ask: {V} accused {P} last meeting and {V} died next.
caveats: Impostors use this to frame crew.
